blocks.text: Amid renewed speculation of a rift between her and fellow SexBomb Girls member Rochelle Pangilinan, Jopay Paguia shared a 2025 interview in which she underscored the “sisterhood” within their group and dismissed claims of a supposed “rivalry.” Through her Facebook page on Saturday, Sept. 19, Paguia reposted a clip from her December 2025 interview with Toni Gonzaga, which also featured fellow SexBomb Girls members Sunshine Garcia and Evette Pabalan. “Ang malaking issue ng SexBomb noon na naaalala ko ay ang rivalry—na pinag-aaway kayo ni Rochelle, na lagi kayong may issue,” the actress-TV host told Paguia.
